title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
title_zh: JevGPT：自主研究中的快思与慢思

paragraphs.en: JevGPT是一种用于自主研究的双系统架构，结合了快速证据处理与审慎的研究规划。 Autonomous research agents must acquire and reason over evidence within a limited budget. Yet relevant sources can remain uninspected or unused, leaving a gap between retrieval coverage and the evidence that informs research. The challenge is to align fast local judgments with changing evidence needs and feed their findings back into research decisions. We introduce JevGPT, a dual-system architecture for autonomous research that couples fast evidence processing with deliberative research planning. System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings, while System One locates support, assesses relevance, and guides further inspection. Independent source judgments run in parallel; selected original passages inform the next research step. Experiments on fixed-corpus question answering and document ranking show that JevGPT achieves leading task performance, with faster completion and lower cost than comparably effective research agents. Evidence analysis shows broader source inspection and greater coverage of supporting documents in the research loop, highlighting efficient evidence processing as a route to more capable autonomous research.
paragraphs.zh: JevGPT是一种用于自主研究的双系统架构，它将快速证据处理与审慎的研究规划相结合。自主研究智能体必须在有限的预算内获取证据并进行推理。 然而，相关来源可能仍未被检查或使用，导致检索覆盖范围与指导研究的证据之间存在差距。 挑战在于如何将快速的局部判断与不断变化的证据需求相协调，并将研究结果反馈到研究决策中。 我们提出了JevGPT，这是一种用于自主研究的双系统架构，它将快速证据处理与深思熟虑的研究规划相结合。 系统二负责设定证据目标并整合研究结果，而系统一则负责定位支持证据、评估相关性并指导进一步检查。 对来源的独立判断并行运行；选定的原始段落将指导下一步研究。 在固定语料库问答和文档排序任务上的实验表明，JevGPT实现了领先的任务性能，其完成速度更快且成本低于同等有效性的研究智能体。 证据分析显示，在研究循环中，JevGPT对来源的检查范围更广，对支持性文档的覆盖也更全面，这凸显了高效的证据处理是提升自主研究能力的重要途径。
